# Vendored runtime assets

These files are TensorFlow.js 4.22.0 runtime assets fetched from the pinned
jsDelivr package URLs and kept locally so the trainer can work offline after
the PWA is installed.

- `tf.min.js`: SHA-384 `vE8hbVJ4lezako5rlvE7bY0BVzWlFhZncPlckrqNwcUQpVtgbENTgZ8TBbnPjZre`
- `tf-backend-webgpu.min.js`: SHA-384 `0cz8Hmjyhn7MyeyzI7MSTOuEdxiSNiwpDDPakM6XjdtC/Fb5/qRxkmLrTJROQqjQ`
